steps.userMessage:
OPEN COURT ATLAS | A basketball game through time, position and score

Open Court Learning Lab needs a visual atlas of Harbor vs Orchard for basketball fans and adults beginning to read tactical graphics. The supplied record contains 48 events, E001–E048, across two six-minute halves: 36 shot attempts, eight rebounds and four turnovers. Harbor has 19 attempts and Orchard has 17. The score begins at 0–0, reaches 13–15 at half-time and finishes at 30–28, always in Harbor–Orchard order. Build the atlas around a reader finding the same event in time, on the court and at its score change.

The direction is fixed: linked timelines, step charts and point maps using Harbor blue #0072B2 with an anchor emblem and Orchard orange #E69F00 with a tree emblem. Pair team colors with direct names and distinct symbols. The global court grid runs from x = 0–100 and y = 0–50 in practice-grid units, with its origin at bottom left and baskets at (5,25) and (95,25). Harbor attacks right in half 1 and left in half 2; Orchard attacks the opposite end. Preserve this orientation throughout. Elapsed time runs from 0 to 720 seconds, with the half boundary at 360. Print "Harbor vs Orchard" and the source credit "Open Court Learning Lab, 2026" on every finished chart, event card, video and presentation title page. Print "OPEN COURT ATLAS" on the written summary and presentation cover.

Audience: basketball fans and tactical-analysis newcomers, with the learning lab's editorial team choosing the graphics for phone reading, arena display and a printed handout.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the project facts and fixed identity. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists every deliverable's proportion, format and stage. events.md supplies the 48 event records. players.md supplies the ten player identities and jersey numbers. game-data.en.md defines the clock, scoring and global coordinates. deliverable-details.en.md supplies event counts and the four focus-event records. court-coordinate-reference.png is the constraint image for the global grid and basket positions. team-emblems.png is the identity image containing the existing Harbor anchor and Orchard tree emblems. courtside-reading-scene.png is an atmosphere reference for phone and arena-screen viewing.

Deliverables:
1. A two-page data summary and chart inventory stating each chart's data columns, chart type, units, carrier and printed wording, with team and result encodings, event-linking examples, clock rules, coordinate orientation, overlap treatment, the 0–720-second range and final score 30–28
2. One landscape overall event timeline containing all 48 events, their event IDs and the 360-second half boundary
3. One landscape cumulative-score step chart containing all 25 scoring changes, half-time and final scores, with E015, E024, E038 and E048 labeled
4. Three shot maps: the full game's 36 attempts, Harbor's 19 attempts and Orchard's 17 attempts, each identifying event ID, half, team, outcome and attempted point value
5. Two half-detail boards, each linking a time strip and global-coordinate map of its 24 events, with starting and ending scores and the half's attacking directions
6. Four key-event summaries for E015, E024, E038 and E048, one card each with half, both time readings, team, player name, jersey number, attempted points, result, points added, before-and-after scores and a location map; E015, E024 and E038 as portrait phone cards, and E048 as a one-page A4 handout with a beginner's reading key
7. One 10-second video following E048 through the timeline, court position and score change, with its event ID visible throughout and the closing score 30–28
8. One presentation of at least eight pages reusing the summary, timeline, score chart, three shot maps, two half details and four event cards, with an explanation of the shared reading system

Acceptance:
- Establish the data summary and chart inventory first. Repeat its 0–720-second range, final score 30–28 and source credit Open Court Learning Lab, 2026 on the overall timeline, score chart and presentation; use its team and outcome encodings across all charts, cards and video.
- On the overall timeline and half-detail boards, preserve all 48 event IDs and actual timestamps. Display E022 before E023 at 319 seconds and E044 before E045 at 660 seconds, with both records individually readable. On the score chart, begin at 0–0, hold 13–15 at 360 seconds and hold 30–28 from 719 through 720 seconds; each scoring increment equals that event's pointsAdded.
- Plot 36, 19 and 17 attempts respectively on the full-game, Harbor and Orchard maps, including all four one-point attempts in the full-game map. On these maps, both half-detail boards and all four event cards, retain the supplied x,y positions, bottom-left origin and half-specific attacking ends; connect displaced labels to their recorded locations.
- On the four event cards, repeat the focus-event records in deliverable-details.en.md and the player names and jerseys in players.md. Link E015, E024, E038 and E048 by identical event IDs across the timeline, score chart, relevant maps, half details and cards. The E048 card and video show Rowan Lin, jersey 15, at (10,25), adding 2 points to change 28–28 into 30–28.
- Give every finished chart and event card a title, visible units, a reading annotation, Harbor vs Orchard and the source credit. Apply direct team labels and distinct symbols, plus distinguishable made, missed, rebound and turnover cues, on every view containing those categories. Preserve those distinctions in grayscale and repeat the relevant wording and units in the video and presentation.
- Deliver the landscape charts, three portrait cards and A4 E048 handout with matching event values. Assemble the presentation last, with at least eight pages and the named preceding artworks; repeat OPEN COURT ATLAS on its cover and the written summary. The 10-second video follows E048 in timeline–position–score order.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
